title: Measurement Optimization in the Variational Quantum Eigensolver Using a Minimum Clique Cover
problem_summary: Groups qubit-wise commuting Hamiltonian terms via a graph-coloring formulation (minimum clique cover, NP-hard but solved with polynomial heuristics), reducing the number of separately-measured operator groups by roughly a factor of 3 on average across tested Hamiltonians.

components.family_or_name: qubit-wise-commuting term grouping via minimum clique cover
components.notes: Average ~3x reduction in the number of measured operator groups vs. individual-term measurement.

workflow_composition_notes: Measurement-grouping preprocessing step applied to the Hamiltonian before the VQE measurement stage; independent of ansatz/optimizer choice.
